1.name: Rear spar
1.note: The wing's aft spar: the flap tracks bolt to its web, the bellcrank's brackets hang off it, and the push-pull rod passes through a slot in it.

2.name: Upper skin and shroud
2.note: The upper skin runs on past the spar over the flap's nose. Its lip is one wall of the slot: the gap is measured from it.

3.name: Lower skin and cove panel
3.note: The lower skin stops at the spar; the curved cove panel behind it wraps the retracted flap's nose and turns the air from below up into the slot.

4.name: Flap
4.note: An aerofoil of its own with a round nose. Slid aft it adds chord; turned down it adds camber; with the slot open its upper surface keeps its flow.

5.name: Flap track
5.spec: 6.35 plate, one slot: straight 100, then R104
5.note: The cam of the whole system: its slot's shape alone decides how far the flap slides before it turns. Two per flap, bolted to the rear spar.

6.name: Roller bracket
6.spec: Two cheeks either side of the track
6.note: Bolted under the flap's nose, it carries the two rollers. Together the rollers fix both where the flap is and how far it has turned.

7.name: Track roller
7.spec: Ø22 sealed ball bearing on an AN4 bolt
7.note: Two to a bracket, 90 mm apart, in the same slot. On the straight both slide aft together; on the curve the aft one drops and the flap turns.

8.name: Drive lug
8.spec: On the notch rib inside the flap's nose
8.note: Where the push-pull rod pushes the flap. It sits high in the nose, so its path along the track never turns back on the rod.

9.name: Push-pull rod
9.spec: Ø12.7 tube, rod ends, 234 pin to pin
9.note: From the bellcrank's outboard arm aft through the spar to the flap's lug: 120 mm of travel moves the flap from 0° to 30°.

10.name: Bellcrank
10.note: Turns about 73° in all. The actuator pushes one arm, the rod hangs on another, the crossed cables and the follow-up cable on the rest.

11.name: Bellcrank bolt and brackets
11.spec: AN5 bolt, two brackets off the rear spar
11.note: The bellcrank's vertical pivot, held top and bottom by brackets riveted to the rear spar's web, ahead of it in the wing box.

12.name: Interconnect cable
12.note: Two cables cross over the cabin from each bellcrank's forward arm to the other's aft arm, so the port flap must follow the starboard one.

13.name: Follow-up cable
13.note: The feedback: from the bellcrank to the selector's switch carrier, it turns the carrier as the flaps move until the switch opens.

14.name: Flap motor
14.spec: 28 V DC permanent magnet, about 0.1 kW
14.note: About 5,500 rpm and 1.5 to 3 A on load. Its two terminals are grounded at rest, which brakes it the moment a switch opens.

15.name: Gearbox housing
15.spec: Two-stage spur gearbox, lug for the mount
15.note: Holds the motor, the idler and the screw's bearings in line, and carries the lug the actuator hangs on at its inboard end.

16.name: Spur gears
16.note: Two reductions of 5:1 turn the motor's speed into the screw's torque: about 220 rpm at the jackscrew.

17.name: Jackscrew
17.note: 4 mm a turn. Its lead angle (5.2°) is less than the friction angle (8.8°), so the air load on the flaps cannot screw it back.

18.name: Nut and striker key
18.spec: Bronze nut, key through the tube's slot
18.note: The key stops the nut turning, so it must travel; at each end of its 131.5 mm stroke the key presses a limit switch's roller.

19.name: Actuating tube and rod end
19.spec: Ø22×2 tube, rod end with AN4 bolt
19.note: Carried by the nut out of the housing over the screw; its rod end pushes the bellcrank's forward arm.

20.name: Housing tube
20.spec: Ø32×2, slotted, bronze bush at its end
20.note: Guides the nut and the actuating tube; its slot lets the striker key out to reach the limit switches.

21.name: Ball bearings
21.spec: 7200 pair face to face, three deep-groove
21.note: The angular-contact pair takes the screw's thrust both ways; the others hold the screw and the idler shaft.

22.name: Limit switch
22.note: UP at the nut's home, DOWN at full stroke. Each opens its own direction's circuit, so the motor can always run back the other way.

23.name: Actuator mount bracket
23.spec: Clevis on the root rib, AN4 pin
23.note: The actuator's fixed end: it swings a few degrees on this pin as the bellcrank turns.

24.name: Selector lever and scale
24.spec: Detents at 0, 10, 20, 30; scale for the pointer
24.note: Push it down for more flap. Its cam leads the carrier; at 0 and 30 its detent lies past the mark, so the limit switches do the stopping.

25.name: Switch carrier
25.spec: Pulley R60, pointer, DOWN and UP switches, return spring
25.note: Turned by the follow-up cable, it chases the lever: when it catches up the cam leaves the switch and the motor stops. Its pointer is the indicator.

26.name: Circuit breaker
26.spec: 10 A, push to reset, marked FLAP
26.note: Guards the flap circuit: a jammed flap stalls the motor at about 15 A and the breaker opens before the wiring overheats.
